cohort: Patients who entered the second stage of labor with singleton, term pregnancies (n = 863, n = 439 nulliparous, n = 424 multiparous)
finding: The number of pushing contractions was associated with the likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery, with probabilities of cesarean delivery peaking after 80 pushing contractions in nulliparous and 50 in multiparous patients.
